qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Leading Portuguese commercial and retail banking franchise with sticky low-cost deposit base and ~20% domestic market share. High switching costs in primary banking relationships, but returns are highly sensitive to ECB rate cycles and regulatory interventions.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Regional Portuguese and Polish commercial bank whose recent earnings recovery is heavily dependent on cyclical ECB interest rate peaks. Spread lending is a commoditized product facing margin compression as policy rates drop, alongside persistent regulatory burdens in Poland (credit holidays, bank tax, CHF litigation).
qualitative.evidence: FY24 net profit reached €906.4M with ROE of 13.8% (FY23 ROE 15.3%), benefiting from high European interest rates. However, Bank Millennium in Poland required €780M in CHF mortgage provisions in 2023 and over €500M in 2024, alongside Polish banking taxes and credit holidays. Spread-lending model lacks 15-year secular advantage durability.
